specs.title: every WiGO component fits one 1440×900 screen
every WiGO component fits one 1440×790 screen
every WiGO component fits one 1920×1080 screen
the comparison band shows 36 metric columns by period with a DIFF row, and drives the game log
the rate percentile slot holds two chips and sparse tiles on two filter lines at 1280×800
a long name and the no-player state stay on one 1280×800 screen
a team-driver card at 95% coverage shows its N-of-M label and still fits 1280×800
every help note opens fully inside the 1280×800 screen and Escape closes it
the phone comparison tab shows the band with a pinned period column, jump buttons and every period and DIFF
1024×768 flows every panel without clipping instead of fitting one screen
1279×800 flows every panel without clipping instead of fitting one screen
1280×700 flows every panel without clipping instead of fitting one screen
